title: Prompt versus workflow
learning_outcome: Distinguish a single probabilistic response from a repeatable workflow and an autonomous agent
evidence: Classify three scenarios and justify the boundary

title: Outcome contract
learning_outcome: Define success failure and acceptable uncertainty before changing prompts
evidence: Write an observable outcome contract for one task

title: Decompose and route
learning_outcome: Split a task into steps and route distinct input classes without needless complexity
evidence: Draw a minimal sequence with at least one justified branch

title: Gates and human approval
learning_outcome: Place deterministic checks stopping conditions and human decisions at consequential boundaries
evidence: Choose gates for a failure scenario and explain why each is deterministic or human

title: Grounding tools and memory
learning_outcome: Choose data retrieval tools or memory only when they reduce a named uncertainty
evidence: Match augmentations to four failure modes and reject one unnecessary augmentation

title: Failure modes and least privilege
learning_outcome: Identify compounding error indirect prompt injection and excessive agency
evidence: Threat-model one workflow and reduce permissions without breaking its outcome

title: Evaluate outcomes
learning_outcome: Create representative tasks criteria and graders that measure durable outcomes rather than fluent traces
evidence: Draft three test cases including one failure case and an outcome-based oracle

title: Reliable workflow canvas
learning_outcome: Synthesize a bounded inspectable workflow for a real task
evidence: Present a workflow canvas with outcome inputs steps gates permissions evals and stop conditions
